title: Office design: where to start — brief, layout and budget

description: Office design: where to start — the team brief, zone planning, style and brand, what an office design project includes and its cost (from $30/m², min. $2,500).
lead: Office design — where do you start if you are fitting out a space for your team for the first time? We explain the order: brief, layout, style and brand, documentation and budget, so the office works for people and for clients.
service: Office design and renovation in Kyiv

body: Start not with Pinterest pictures but with an understanding of how the company will work in the new space. An office is a tool: it should help people focus, agree quickly and look good to clients. Style and colours matter, but they come after function.
The brief: which answers to prepare
how many people work in the office now and how many with room for growth
which departments work together and who needs quiet
how many meeting rooms you need and what size
whether clients visit and what they should see
which equipment and technology are needed
the budget and the desired move-in date
A short brief saves weeks of approvals: the designer immediately proposes several layout options for the real task rather than for an abstract «modern office».

Next we place the zones: workstations, meeting rooms, call booths, kitchen, rest area, reception, technical rooms. Routes should be short, and noisy zones should not sit next to quiet ones. The first big decision here is open space or private offices; for IT teams there is a separate page on [open-space office design](/en/open-space-office-design).
Open-plan office with an island of live plants between desks — Office Chicago
Zoning without solid walls at Office Chicago
Style and brand in the space

Once the layout is approved, we move on to the concept: materials, colours, light, the company brand in the space. Reception and the client meeting room work as a business card — corporate colours and quality materials are appropriate here. In work zones, comfort, quiet and even glare-free light on monitors matter more.
An example is [Office Chicago](/en/proekty/office-chicago): zoning without solid walls, green walls, linear lighting above workstations and a kitchen-café.
Lounge area with leather armchairs next to a shelving unit — Office Chicago
What an office design project includes
a measured survey and a layout with furniture arrangement
drawings of partitions, ceilings and floors
a specification of materials and furniture
the basis for the renovation estimate
planning exactly for the current headcount, with no margin
making all meeting rooms equally large
forgetting places for calls and video meetings
choosing light fittings for their looks rather than the light at the desk
ordering furniture after the renovation and waiting for it in an empty office
ignoring the business centre's rules on alterations
Most of these mistakes are cheap to fix on paper and expensive after the renovation. That is exactly why the design project is done before construction starts, not in parallel with it.

A design project at CAS starts from $30 per m², with a minimum price of $2,500. As a guide: a 200 m² office from $6,000 (200 × $30), a 50 m² office at the minimum price of $2,500. Office renovation is separate, from $350 per m² (works and rough materials); finishing materials, furniture and appliances are per estimate.
We fix the exact cost of design and renovation after the brief and measurements. More on the budget in our article on office renovation costs.

Design, renovation and furniture are handled by one team, so decisions from the drawings do not get lost on site. More on the [office design in Kyiv](/en/office-design) page. We do the design, draw up an itemised estimate and take the office from demolition to furniture. You have one manager, photo reports every 1–2 weeks, an online camera 24/7 for an extra fee and a 12-month warranty on the works. Our own in-house team does the work, not subcontractors. If CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. We have completed 150+ projects since 2016; a phone consultation is free.
faq: With a brief: headcount, how departments work, how many meeting rooms, whether clients visit, the budget and the move-in date. Then come the layout, concept and documentation.
How much does office design cost?
From $30 per m², with a minimum project price of $2,500. Office renovation is separate, from $350 per m².
Can I order only the design project?
Yes. But the risks are lowest when design, renovation and furniture are handled by one team.
Will you select furniture for the design?
Yes, we put the furniture specification into the design and can furnish the office directly from factories in China; delivery takes 35–70 days.
